remarks: Located behind a pretty stone wall on a quiet Broad River street, this spacious and bright newly updated first floor unit welcomes you as soon as you enter. Comprising the entire first floor of this 2-family home, it's spacious and comfortable and includes the flexible space of a first-floor sunroom, perfect for an office, den or playroom. New updates include new bathroom, refreshed hardwood floors, and fresh paint throughout. Lovely kitchen with new countertops includes a gas range and a dishwasher. Private deck for leisurely afternoons and a yard space for play. Laundry and storage in basement. Landlord pays for lawn care and snow removal. Low utilities include flat rate electric and water. Walk to shops and restaurants. Excellent commuting location with easy access to Merritt Parkway and rte 7. Off-street assigned parking for 2 cars.
